The '''shuttles''' of the [[Eternal Empire]] [[Eternal Empire military|military]], also known as '''Zakuul dropships''', were [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] used to transport personnel of the [[Eternal Empire]] and later repurposed by the [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref>

The Eternal Empire shuttle was an elaborate model of assault-shuttle designed like all Eternal Empire vessels for optimum speed and technology derived and engineered from [[Zakuul]]'s [[Eternal Fleet]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''</ref>

This particular model of shuttle also shared many striking similarities with the [[Eternal Empire Walker]], also used by the Eternal Empire.

==History==
The first instance of this vessel seen was during the [[Attack on Korriban]] in [[3636 BBY]] when the Twin Princes [[Arcann]] and [[Thexan]] boarded one of these starships at the end of the carnage of the battle and then sped off through the dusty skies of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and arrived at the [[Eternal Throne]] on Zakuul.<ref name="Sacrifice cinematic trailer">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/sacrifice|text="Sacrifice"|int=Sacrifice (cinematic trailer)}}</ref>

A specimen of the Eternal Empire shuttle was also spotted on [[Kira Carsen's ship|Kira Carsen's Ship]], [[Mission to Kira Carsen's ship|during the battle that took place]] this specimen was used by the [[Scions of Zakuul]] to board the ship to resurrect [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]] but were later wiped out by the fanatical [[Servant]]s when both proceeded to fight over who had the best interpretation of the will of their master. This specimen was promptly ejected into the vacuum of space by the Outlander.

The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] of the splinter faction [[Hidden Chain]] used at least one Eternal Empire shuttle to deploy troops during the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk]]. The Hidden Chain leader, [[Heta Kol]], eventually escaped the battle with that shuttle.<ref name="TOR:SoR" />
